judge: package-author agent, unblinded, after reading actual responses and expectations
generator_context: One continuing evaluation agent, previously used for B13–B16; B17–B24 answered sequentially in one context. Not fresh contexts or independent samples. The responding agent reported expectations/rubric/results withheld for this run.

cases.evidence: 括號均為A提案，並非已有設計
cases.reason: Identifies presupposed benefit/mechanism, preserves a provisional intervention target, provides scoped discovery and contrary queries without claiming execution, treats AI leads as unverified, and delivers analysis without a reading quiz.

cases.evidence: 不需只為刪除effect而改成關聯性問題
cases.reason: Retains the clear causal question, allows positive/null/harmful answers, separates causal intent from identifying assumptions, and makes no effect estimate.

cases.evidence: 至多辨認出兩個標記資料來源
cases.reason: Separates reports and datasets without assuming full independence, rejects certainty and meta-analysis from a meter, and specifies quality, selection, precision, comparability and source checks.

Keeps qualitative inquiry and optional SPIDER, labels sensitive concepts as proposals rather than discovered themes, proceeds with conceptual work without data upload, and retains direct/reflexive engagement.

cases.evidence: 你會先從其中一篇原文找出哪一項資訊
cases.reason: Preserves actual initial judgment and reason, asks exactly one consequential question, and stops without a checklist, completed answer, or fabricated decision.

Supplies an exact 50-minute nine-person simultaneous-triad design, executable labeled fictional and contrary packets, individual first reasoning, source audit, accessible explanation and owned revision. No learner performance or real health study is invented.

cases.evidence: 每個用途需要與任務相符的驗證
cases.reason: Provides proportionate reproducible review-method planning, human validation/accountability and method-level disclosure. Distinguishes PRISMA/registration scope and does not execute the review or prohibit all AI assistance.

cases.evidence: 查不到其他文獻只表示本次查詢未找到
cases.reason: Rejects brand-based infallibility, bounds conclusions to actually available abstract text, keeps mechanism unverified, does not declare a gap, and continues independent conceptual analysis.

limitations: One continuing context and one response per case; prior teaching trial exposure
No control condition, blinded review or repeated sampling
No human learning-gain or research-outcome evaluation
No actual external search or confidential-data workflow was executed by the trial agent
